content:
jessica-cs: Ping — FinTechCo filed an urgent ticket: after last night's canary the structured output for transaction objects sometimes contains Python-style literals and single quotes, which breaks their strict JSON parser.

sophie-support: Can you paste the customer's request ID and a small excerpt of the model response? Also which model/route were they using?

jessica-cs: request_id=fin-3462-req
route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-2.3-opt, rollout: canary->prod 2025-11-18T22:10Z)

jessica-cs: customer included this sample response from our API (they parse it client-side and hit JSONDecodeError):
```
{
  'order_id': 123456,
  'transaction_type': None,
  'items': [{'sku': 'X100', 'qty': 2}, {'sku': 'Y200', 'qty': 1}],
  'metadata': "note: customer's internal id=abc123\n",
}
```

sophie-support: omg that is Python-literal style. They expect strict JSON (double quotes, null not None). Did the customer have any prompt instructions that might have caused this formatting?

mike-ml: we saw a formatting patch land in the postproc layer yesterday to 'relax' strict JSON enforcement to allow some free-form responses. @arjun-eng any recent config changes on structured-output handlers?

arjun-eng: yes, the structured-output microservice had a rollback to handle an upstream lib update. There was also a config flip: "allow_single_quotes": true temporarily for a canary. sounds like it got promoted. Deploy bot logs show:
```
deploy-bot: canary rollout redwood-2.3-opt -> 100% for route /v1/generate at 2025-11-18T22:08:45Z
deploy-bot: config change: structured_output.strict=false, allow_single_quotes=true
```

jessica-cs: customer says this started ~22:15 UTC. They had strict parser and can't accept None/True/False or single quotes.

lucas-sre: I can see the config promotion in console; policy changed accidentally during the patch. We should triage whether this is server-side postprocessing or tokenization prompting the model to output Python-literals.

mike-ml: quick check: if model emits single quotes or Python 'None' it's likely postproc lib converting tokens. Need raw model tokens. Can you pull the raw response blob for request_id fin-3462-req?

jessica-cs: uploaded raw_blob to the case: s3://reports/fintechco/fin-3462/raw_response.json

arjun-eng: fetching blob now... got it. Raw model output starts like:
```
{\n  'order_id': 123456,\n  'transaction_type': None,\n  'items': [\n    {'sku': 'X100', 'qty': 2},\n    {'sku': 'Y200', 'qty': 1}\n  ]\n}
```

mike-ml: that confirms model produced single quotes, not our postproc. Either prompt injected Python-style examples or the new model variant has an output-formatting regression. Any evals that compare redwood-2.2 vs 2.3 on structured-output?

arjun-eng: running a quick diff job on staging. If it's model-level, we should rollback config and pin to redwood-2.2 for affected customers. Sophie — can we offer a temporary workaround to FinTechCo (parse tolerant + replacement of single quotes and None -> null) while we fix?

sophie-support: yes, will propose a hotfix script and an emergency rollback option. I'll ask for permission to migrate them to a pinned profile until we resolve. :pray:

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: structured_output.strict=true, allow_single_quotes=false for route /v1/generate. awaiting approval from release-leads.

jessica-cs: customer asking for repro steps so their devs can validate fixes. Suggested steps:
1) call /v1/generate with same prompt and model redwood-2.3-opt with their API key
2) inspect 'raw_model_output' in response
3) run strict JSON parse -> should fail on single quotes/None

arjun-eng: action items:
- [ ] mike-ml run regression tests comparing 2.2 vs 2.3 on 1000 structured-output prompts
- [ ] lucas-sre approve and execute rollback if tests show regression
- [ ] devex provide a quick parsing-mitigation snippet for customers
- [ ] cs follow up with FinTechCo and coordinate pinning

sophie-support: thanks everyone. I'll update the case and wait for rollback status. If rollback takes >30m we'll provide the hotfix script.

jessica-cs: +1. Customer is paused on deployment until we confirm.

lucas-sre: rollback approved and executed at 2025-11-18T22:29:05Z. Monitoring for further errors. :white_check_mark:

sophie-support: customer confirmed they retried and parsing succeeded after rollback. closing loop — will file formal postmortem if needed.

mike-ml: leaving a note to revert the 'relax formatting' patch and add stricter unit tests for JSON output formatting.

jessica-cs: thanks team. Case closed for now. :tada:
